title: A painted argument
audio: picture only; optional draft narration cues below

beats.title: The familiar
beats.headline: An act we can see.
beats.motion: Ordinary painted cup arrives on a fixed painted field.
beats.narrationCue: A helpful act is something we can observe.

beats.title: The impossible
beats.headline: A reason we infer.
beats.motion: A direct cut replaces the cup with an impossible architectural interior, at a comparable size and foot position.
beats.narrationCue: Its reason is harder to see. We imagine what might be inside.

beats.title: The distinction
beats.headline: An imagined interior.
beats.motion: The object settles smaller; two drawn leaders separate observation from interpretation.
beats.narrationCue: But an imagined interior is an interpretation. The outward act and our explanation are different things.

beats.title: The explanation
beats.headline: Different reasons. Same act.
beats.motion: The cup moves aside and an authored diagram draws two possible reasons toward one visible result.
beats.narrationCue: Concern and incentive can both lead to help. Behavior alone leaves the reason open.

interpretationNotes: The cup is a conceptual metaphor; no literal AI architecture is depicted.
Concern and incentive are illustrative possibilities, not exhaustive or mutually exclusive categories.
The diagram describes a many-to-one possibility, not proof of any particular motive.
Draft narration is not voiced, aligned to a recording, or adopted into the episode script.
